Package parking.application.usecase

package parking.application.usecase
Application layer: use cases (Clean Architecture's "application business rules").

Each class here represents exactly one operation the system can perform (check a vehicle in, register a payment, list available spaces, and so on) and exposes it through a single execute method. Use cases depend only on the domain layer - its entities and its repository ports - never on a concrete storage mechanism or on any presentation detail. This keeps them trivially testable and reusable from any delivery mechanism (a console app, a REST controller, a test suite) without modification.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CheckInVehicleUseCase
    Checks a vehicle into the parking lot: validates it does not already have an active ticket, finds and occupies a compatible available space, and opens a new ticket for it.
    CheckOutVehicleUseCase
    Checks a vehicle out of the parking lot: closes its active ticket (which computes the final amount) and releases the space it occupied.
    GetOccupancyByTypeUseCase
    Computes how many spaces of each type are available, occupied, and out of service.
    GetTotalRevenueUseCase
    Computes the total revenue collected across every registered payment.
    ListActiveTicketsUseCase
    Lists every currently active ticket.
    ListAvailableSpacesUseCase
    Lists every currently available space of a given type.

    RegisterVehicleUseCase
